about: Feature-layer index parity artifact (gff3-validator issue #31). Each case is one GFF3 fixture in this directory plus one featureId, and the outcome the K4 predicate must report. The contract is docs/feature-index.md; the vocabulary and the not-scored rule are the parts a consumer must not invent for itself.
rule: A case whose outcome is in never_scored answers nothing: a consumer must report K4 as not checked, must not count it as a pass, and must not count it as a rejection.
predicate: found means exactly one row of the feature layer carries the percent-decoded featureId (both sides decoded) and that row's column 3 is 'gene' or 'SO:0000704'. The row count is judged before the type.

javascript.read_from: FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools-JavaScript src/fhgm.js and src/features.js at origin/main 8fd467dab0e8 (merged PR #21 a645bb87675e; rules.K4 and records[].featureTarget.verdict)

cases.why: one gene row carries the ID
the only row with that ID is an mRNA row
a usable layer with no such row
the file has one gene row, with another ID
two rows share the ID; the count is judged before the type, so this is not non-gene-target
exactly one row, and it is not a gene row
the target and the row carry the same escape
decoded on both sides: the header states the identifier, the row states its column-9 escaping; a raw-featureId lookup would call this not-found
a gene row with this ID is present and would match, but another row is not nine fields, so no count is trustworthy
directives and comments only: there is no feature layer to resolve against
the gene row is typed SO:0000704, the accession of gene, accepted as a literal
a layer of rows with no identifiers: not-found, and distinctly not absent-layer
the upper-case spelling of the same identifier selects the same two rows
gene:C%3BB and gene:C%3bB are one identifier written twice; decoding collapses them
the row is above ##FASTA
the index stops at ##FASTA; GFF-DIR-004 is the rule that judges a feature line after it
a malformed escape is left as written on both sides: identifiers are data
a FASTA section begun by '>' without ##FASTA puts non-row lines in the layer
one row carries the first ID tag
the second ID tag on the same row is not an addressable identifier
an ID tag with no value is not an identifier
lone-CR line endings split lines per FORMAT R1; the gene row is indexed
CRLF line endings split lines per FORMAT R1; the gene row is indexed
mixed CR, CRLF and LF line endings split lines per FORMAT R1; the gene row is indexed

synthetic.input: a path that does not exist
synthetic.why: unreadable input is absent, and the reason is recorded; this must not read as not-found
a stream that stops may have lost both rows and defects
